title: If the Move To term was deactivated meanwhile, the move is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Two Admins work at once; one moves a customer to Net 45 while the other switches Net 45 off.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-33 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-33 Solo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Deactivate".
  6. In your browser, click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 4: {User-B}'s menu opens.
  • Step 5: {User-B} sees "Net 45 deactivated".
  • Step 6: the app's error alert shows "Pick an active term other than {Term-A}." and the window stays open; {Customer-A} is still on {Term-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If the chosen "Move To" term was deactivated or deleted meanwhile, the move is refused with "Pick an active term other than {from term}." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To term no longer active (server) | "Pick an active term other than {from term}." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
